recipient_role: HR, application inbox named in the advert
subject: Trainee Structural Drafter, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Trainee Structural Drafter role advertised on SEEK.

I know the ad is written with school leavers and TAFE starters in mind. I have more study behind me than that, and I'm happy to start at trainee level because drafting is the work I want to do. I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I drew road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also built a 3D model of a pedestrian truss bridge in Revit, so Revit isn't new to me, though my use of it is from coursework.

Before the diploma I worked on site in the Philippines for about a year, reviewing structural and architectural drawings, checking the work against them and keeping site records. It left me with the habit of reading drawings closely.

I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney. I hold a White Card and a driver's licence, and I have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. My drawings are at macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio if that helps. I'd be glad to have a short call.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application for Trainee Structural Drafter
paragraphs: I'm writing about the Trainee Structural Drafter role with JHA's Structural & Civil team, advertised on SEEK. I want to start in drafting, learn Revit properly and grow with a consultancy that trains its drafters alongside its engineers, which the ad says JHA does and which fits a firm that has grown from a Sydney start to around 300 people.

My drafting so far is from study. In the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design I finished at Albright Institute in February 2026, I prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards for road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs, modelled a pedestrian Warren truss bridge in Revit and a footing and column in AutoCAD 3D. Before that I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019, which covered structural principles and construction methods.

My site experience is from the Philippines in 2019 and 2020: a community hall renovation as project-in-charge, where I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them, and subdivision finishing works as a field engineer, where I kept site reports and material records. Reading drawings carefully and keeping accurate records is what I'm used to.

The ad is aimed at school leavers and TAFE starters. I have more study than that, but no commercial drafting experience yet, and I'm glad to start at trainee level and learn JHA's standards from the ground up. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney. I hold a White Card and a driver's licence and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be happy to come in and show you the models.

notes: Advert asks for resume and brief cover letter by email to hr@jhaengineers.com.au. Aimed at school leavers; Marc is overqualified and the email says so honestly. JHA people page names Jarrod Grimshaw (Director, structural design) and Nemesio Biason Jr (Civil Group Manager) without emails, so the letter is addressed to the Structural & Civil team and the email goes to hr@ as instructed.
